calibration_rule.pairwise_threshold: freeze after running the known-positive hand through the same audit; suggested starting rule is 1.25x the positive-reference pairwise error
calibration_rule.mask_threshold: optional; freeze only if candidate and target hand masks use the same raster and occlusion convention

notes: Do not fill thresholds after seeing the v3 candidate results.
A reflected-only fit can never authorize a 3D hand reflection.
The existing RMSE and p95 limits are inherited from the registered Branch-E diagnostic; confirm the same normalization convention before use.
